title: A Tale of Two Identities: An Ethical Audit of Human and AI-Crafted Personas

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM-generated synthetic personas to authentic human-authored self-descriptions across different racial groups using TF-IDF for lexical divergence, log-odds ratio analysis to identify markedness and algorithmic othering, sentiment analysis (VADER and RoBERTa) to detect benevolent bias, and a parameterized creativity framework measuring semantic diversity, novelty, complexity, and surprisal.
